title: Petal n Pins
summary: Luxury digital flowers and custom pins e-commerce platform with automated payment workflows.
description: A premium, custom e-commerce solution featuring dynamic product grids, customizable flower configurations, and stripe/razorpay validation suites.
detailedDescription: Designed to prevent transaction dropoffs. It features automated invoice mapping, custom bouquet builders, wishlist tracking, and Razorpay webhook hooks to prevent payment leakage.
challenges: Preventing double-verification leaks in high-volume transaction environments.
results: Designed and verified a dual-pair Razorpay signature webhook parser that checks database checkout statuses prior to processing webhook hooks.

title: NOVA Assistant
description: Neural Operating Virtual Architecture built to assist portfolio visitors with natural speech interaction.
detailedDescription: Handles natural speech transcription, processes intents locally, manages session context, and speaks synthesized voice replies with an audio-reactive particle lattice.
challenges: Synchronizing SpeechRecognition threads with standard web synthesis utterances without double-trigger conflicts.
results: Engineered a unified ref state controller that acts as a gatekeeper, pausing browser audio capture during speech synthesis.

title: Shadab OS
summary: A premium, Apple-inspired 3D virtual workspace portfolio system.
description: An immersive landing operating environment designed to demonstrate WebGL interactive capabilities.
detailedDescription: Maps standard portfolio pages to 3D projected coordinate grids, integrating layout-composites and mouse parallax scroll-driven coordinate warping.
challenges: Maintaining performance during complex coordinate grid transformations and dynamic scroll calculations on mobile.
results: Optimized calculations by caching matrix translations and utilizing dynamic viewport scaling to keep frame rates steady at 60fps.

title: Nōva — Luxury E-commerce
summary: Full identity system for a luxury e-commerce platform.
description: A premium visual design system consisting of logo, typography, colour tokens, motion guidelines, and deliverables.
detailedDescription: The brand needed to feel premium yet approachable. Every touchpoint had to whisper luxury without shouting it. Includes 18 deliverables produced in 6 weeks.
challenges: Developing a luxury visual system that scales across print, packaging, and digital checkout pages.
results: Completed visual guidelines leading to a 3× conversion lift in the first 90 days post-launch.

title: Bloom — Wellness App
summary: Calm, gesture-first iOS/Android UX for daily mindfulness.
description: Mindfulness app designed for busy people who think they don't have time to meditate.
detailedDescription: Most wellness apps feel clinical. Bloom was designed to feel like a warm friend, utilizing micro-gestures and clean visual cues.
challenges: Making complex meditation paths feel lightweight and inviting for first-time practitioners.
results: Achieved a 4.9★ rating on App Store launch day and was featured by Apple in 'Apps We Love'.

title: Folio — Portfolio System
summary: A modular design system for creative portfolios.
description: A comprehensive kit of components, tokens, templates, and documentation used by 200+ designers.
detailedDescription: Designed to help senior and junior designers launch layouts quickly, avoiding spending weeks on portfolio setup instead of client work.
challenges: Balancing layout customizability with strict modular layout alignment constraints.
results: Launched library with 200+ active users. Covered by Design Milk and The Brand Identity.

title: Pulse — Finance Tracker
summary: Dark-mode iOS dashboard with adaptive spending insights.
description: Finance tracker app that turns raw bank data into visual stories you actually understand.
detailedDescription: Finance apps are either too simple or too complex. Pulse was built to sit in the sweet spot using clean dark-mode visuals.
challenges: Visualizing dense transaction data and category spending trends on a constrained mobile viewport.
results: Acquired by a FinTech startup 8 months after launch with 12,000+ active users.
